summary.zh: 夏毛带白斑；日本奈良公园的鹿被视为神明使者。
summary.en: White-spotted summer coat; the deer of Nara Park, Japan, are regarded as sacred messengers.

field_marks.zh: 夏季体侧有白色斑点，臀部有白色斑块；雄鹿有分叉角。
field_marks.en: White spots on the flanks in summer and a pale rump patch; stags have branched antlers.

story.zh: 鹿科在偶蹄目反刍类中与牛科、长颈鹿近缘，年轻的角每年脱落重生。
story.en: Deer belong to the ruminant artiodactyls and are close to bovids and giraffes; antlers are shed and regrown annually.

notes.zh: 奈良公园全年可见，春夏有小鹿；秋季发情期雄鹿具攻击性，应保持距离。
notes.en: Visible all year at Nara Park, fawns in spring and summer; stags are aggressive in the autumn rut, so keep distance.

etiquette.zh: 只喂景区出售的鹿仙贝，不要拉扯鹿角或尾巴，不要在发情期靠近雄鹿。
etiquette.en: Feed only the crackers sold on site; do not pull antlers or tails and keep away from stags during the rut.
